subject: Obstruction - Cabot Strait - south - North Sydney
text:
Obstruction - Cabot Strait - south - North Sydney
Diving operations underway at the Canadian Maritime Engineering Dock (CME) North Sydney, daily from 1100UTC until 1900UTC. Dive flags will mark the area and VHF channels 08 and 16 will be monitored for concerned traffic. Minimum wash requested in the vicinity of operations.
